title: Zulm Hai Andera Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
body:
Zulm Hai Andera Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
Gham Ka Ab Savera Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
Bad-e-Shah-e-Deen Uspar Har Sitam Huwa Khul-Kar
Margyi Hai Wo Pyasi Dekthi Rahi Madar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisa Uss-Ka Marna Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
Shimr Ke Tamache The Ranj-o-Gham Ke Saye The
Raha Me Sakina Ke Aafato Ke Kante The
Haye Kya Andhera Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Be-Kajawa Ountoun Par Le-Gaye Laien Dar-Dar
Dekhti Rahi Bibi Baap Ka Sina Par Sar
Nazroun Me Madina Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
Bekasi Ka Aalam Hai Sab Ki Aankh Purnam Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Teergi Me Zindan Ki Binte Shai Ka Matam Hai
Haal Hai Wo Zinda Ka Qaid Mai Sakina Hai
Lake Sar Wo Baba Ka Shai Se Guftagu Ki Jo
Dekho Tho Zara Abid Sogayi Hai Kya Dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Gazab Ka Sona Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
Marte Waqt Bhai Se Ye Kaha Sakina Ne
Ho Muqam Ek Thanda Dafan Mujhko Wa Kije
Qush Mera Sina Hai Qaid Me Sakina Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Nouha Likthe Hai Hyder Aur Sunate Hai Jaffer
Majlis-e-aza Me Hai Sab Ki Ab Zubano Par
Dekhle Zara Dunya Qaid Me Sakina Hai
